$description: Snapshot of a Figma library, written by packages/tokens/scripts/figma/export.js. Don't edit by hand: refresh it from Figma. The drift tests check the token sources and figma.ts against it.

5:489.name: Sheet
5:489.description: The paper sheet a web page sits on: the card stock's tall cut, Imagery/Paper 2:3, stretched over tertiary-container, pinned to the Light scheme (the paper is a light raster). Desktop: an 800px column, a 4px on-secondary border, 20/24/16 padding. Mobile (below 640px): full width, 16px padding, no border. Put the page into Content; children stack 20px apart. .lk-sheet.

5:496.name: Stage
5:496.description: A full-bleed web backdrop: Imagery/Palm Sky, cover, over primary-container. Desktop centres its Page 32px from the top with 16px sides; Mobile runs the page edge to edge. Holds a Sheet. .lk-stage.

5:395.name: Tag
5:395.description: A short uppercase label chip. .lk-tag. Used in a wrapping row of 4px gaps (profile tags, Link Row tags).

5:399.name: Icon Kicker
5:399.description: Category label above a row or tile title: a 16px icon in a 4px box, then a mono uppercase label in scrim at 80%. .lk-kicker. Studio uses the Command glyph; Blog Feather; Shop and Support Layout Grid.

5:405.name: Pill Button
5:405.description: Header link (Ghost) and Follow (Outlined). Mono 11px, full radius. .lk-header__link, .lk-follow. Hover: Ghost takes surface-container-lowest at 40%, Outlined surface-container-high. Focus draws a 2px primary ring (:focus-visible). Ghost hides below 640px in the header.

5:420.name: Icon Button
5:420.description: 32px round button on inverse-surface; the icon takes inverse-on-surface. Social: 18px icon (.lk-social). Go: 20px chevron at the end of a Link Row (.lk-row__go). Hover lifts to primary (on a Link Row, hovering the row lifts its Go). Needs an aria-label in code (the social kind).

5:432.name: Tab
5:432.description: Filter tab: a toggle button (aria-pressed), 46px tall, 10px radius, comic lettering. .lk-tab. Hover takes surface-container-lowest at 40%; Selected sits on surface-container-lowest with an outline; Focus draws a 2px primary ring. Fills its grid cell (FILL width) in a row of five.

5:447.name: Avatar
5:447.description: Round profile photo with a 1px on-surface ring over tertiary-98 (shown when there is no photo). Large 172px; Compact 120px below 640px. .lk-avatar. Photo fill: Imagery/Portrait.

5:233.name: Link Tile
5:233.description: A short link under the rows: kicker plus a burst label, centred, at least 80px tall. Three to a row on desktop, one per row on mobile. Hover is new here; code has none yet. .lk-tile. Copy: LINK_SAMPLE.tiles.

5:176.name: Link Row

Description.default: Projects, experiments, products, music, and an ongoing exploration of what’s possible.

5:176.description: One link: media, then kicker, title, description and tags, then the Go button. The whole row is the link (an <a> when it has an href). Desktop: media 210–280px wide, 160 tall, beside the text. Mobile: media full width, 180 tall, above the text. Media without an image shows scrim at 80%; put an image fill on Media to use one. Kicker is exposed: set its Icon (Studio Command, Blog Feather, Shop/Support Layout Grid) and Label. Hover lifts the row to surface-container-lowest and the Go button to primary. Was Workbench Link Row 118:515. .lk-row. Tags is a slot: fill it with Tag instances (Primitives), as many as the item has.

5:161.name: Tab Bar
5:161.description: Filters the Link Rows: All, Studio, Blog, Shop, Support (a role="group" of toggle buttons). Desktop: five equal cells, 8px apart. Mobile: tabs hug their labels and the row scrolls sideways (scrollbar hidden). Swap a Tab to State=Selected to show the active filter. .lk-tabs.

5:128.name: Link Profile

Bio.default: Projects, experiments, products, music, and an ongoing exploration of what’s possible

5:128.description: Profile: Avatar, the name as the page h1, tags, bio (scrim 60%) and social Icon Buttons, each needing an aria-label in code. Desktop sits side by side; Mobile stacks with the Compact avatar and a 38px name. .lk-profile. Copy: LINK_SAMPLE.profile. Tags is a slot: fill it with Tag instances (Primitives), as many as the item has.

5:113.name: Link Header
5:113.description: Link page header: the wordmark, then Blog and Shop (Pill Button, Ghost) and Follow (Outlined) at the right. Mobile drops the ghost links and shrinks the wordmark to 26px. .lk-header. Copy: LINK_SAMPLE.wordmark, nav, follow.

5:612.name: Link Page
5:612.description: The link-in-bio page (apps/links, :5179): Stage › Sheet › Link Header, Link Profile, Tab Bar, four Link Rows and three Link Tiles. Desktop is the 800px sheet on a 1280 stage; Mobile is 390, below the 640px breakpoint. Copy is LINK_SAMPLE (@jkidd/blocks/link sample.ts); live hrefs live in apps/links/src/links.ts and are never invented. Rebuilt from JKidd - Workbench Linktrees (120:1335 page, 118:515 row) as live layers through all five libraries. In code: <LinkPage spec={LINKS} /> from @jkidd/blocks/link.
